data.one_liner: Observable data holders inspired by Android LiveData with lazy activation and history.
data.what_it_does: Provides observable data holders, one-shot events, reactive mediators, history, persistence, and collection wrappers inspired by Android LiveData. Integrates with Flutter through dedicated widget builders and an observer mixin.
use_when: You want Android LiveData style observables in Flutter
You need undo/redo history or persistence for individual state objects and collections
You prefer an imperative/reactive wrapper model without code generation
avoid_when: You are already using a different major state management solution like BLoC or Riverpod
You require complex unidirectional data flow architectures
strengths: Includes built-in support for collections, events, history, and storage
Seamlessly integrates with Flutter's Listenable and ValueListenable
Lazy activation and mediator patterns out of the box
weaknesses: Strict runtime checks that throw StateError on duplicate observers or uninitialized reads
Niche state management paradigm tailored after Android LiveData
